name: Senagawa Satsuki
source: Senagava is a novice designer and has many other hidden talents. However, she leads a "boy in the skirt" lifestyle, and doesn't like to go to school. It would seem that she is unknown to such term as "Lady", and she can even kick your ass, when she gets pissed off. But love can change a person incredibly. And even Satsuki has her feminine side.
